title: Partitions – Boarding & Close-up
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Board type, thickness and layers match the wall type label; joints staggered 600 mm?

guide.title: Drylining – British Gypsum figures
rows: 600 mm max (400 mm where specified / tiled)
max 50 mm from the track end
studs NOT screwed to the head track; 15–20 mm gap kept
guide.note: SJWS Field issues: studs screwed to the head track, corner screws at 290 mm, stagger only 123 mm – all fails.
guide.src: British Gypsum White Book (Gypwall / GypLyner) – confirm wall type; MEA ITP acceptance criteria; Field issues

questions.q: Screws at 300 mm centres (200 mm at external angles), at least 10 mm from board edges?
Insulation the wall-type thickness, tight to studs with no gaps at the head or base?
GFS1 straps behind every horizontal board joint not on a noggin?

questions.q: Ask the fitter: What board stagger and screw centres does this wall type need? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Has the MEP handover been received and photos taken before the second side closes?
questions.source: Errigal ITP – hold point before closure

questions.q: Are cavities clear of debris before closing?
Wall on its setting-out line within ±1 mm, and flat within a 4 mm deviation band?

guide.title: Drylining – EPR finish tolerances
rows: Class 5a – 2 mm under a 2 m straightedge
5 mm max gap, filled before skirting
300 mm centres, 200 mm at external angles, ≥10 mm from edges
guide.note: EPR says these are tighter than BS 8000-8 – EPR governs. The board system follows the approved tech sub.

guideRS.title: Riding School – drylining tolerances
rows: ±2 mm or 0.1% of height – whichever is less
±2 mm or 0.1% of length – whichever is less
2 mm under a 3 m straightedge; 1 mm under 1 m
guideRS.note: Riding School is a separate WEA spec – stud centres vary 400/600 mm by wall type and heights go up to 6.1 m. Check the wall type label.

questions.q: Plaster beads fixed with ≥75 mm steel fixings at ≤450 mm centres?
Riser door perimeter gaps 3 mm (±1 mm), lock/cylinder working?
Air temperature between +5°C and +30°C during boarding and jointing?

notOk.t: Board joints staggered less than 600 mm (123–285 mm recorded on SJWS)
Screws missing the stud / driven too deep
Corner screw centres over 200 mm (up to 290 mm recorded)
Narrow slivers of board at openings (poor setting out)
Tape and jointing missing at low level behind skirting
Damaged board or paper facing peeling left in
Gaps around back boxes in acoustic / fire walls

ask.q: What screw centres and edge distance?
ask.a: 300 mm centres (200 mm at external angles), at least 10 mm from board edges (EPR 22).

ask.q: What board stagger does this wall type need?
ask.a: Joints staggered 600 mm between layers and sides.
Boards kept up to 5 mm off the floor, filled before skirting.

ask.q: What flatness are you boarding to?
ask.a: On the setting-out line ±1 mm, within a 4 mm deviation band (EPR – tighter than BS 8000-8).
